title: Correlating Patient Symptoms and CT Morphology in AI-Detected Incidental Pulmonary Embolisms.
summary: In a retrospective review of 13,603 non-angiography CT scans, an AI triage system identified 41 radiologist-confirmed incidental pulmonary emboli, followed by clinical and CT-morphology characterization; this is a narrow single-centre detection/correlation result, not an estimate of sensitivity or population prevalence.
ai_technology: A deployed CNN flags incidental emboli on contrast CT; the flagged cases are then clinically and radiologically characterized.
organization: General Hospital Salzburg, Müllnerhauptstrasse 48, 5020 Salzburg, Austria
